title: Stub PluginProcessor with generic editor
description:
Create minimal JUCE AudioProcessor stubs in Source/PluginProcessor.h and Source/PluginProcessor.cpp. createEditor must return a juce::GenericAudioProcessorEditor. Do NOT include PluginEditor.h. No real DSP, APVTS, or layout yet—empty prepareToPlay/processBlock/releaseResources that compile.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in allowed_write_paths.

Before editing, inspect: JUCE AudioProcessor API expectations and CMake target_sources name for the processor.
acceptance_criteria: No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: heap allocate on the audio thread beyond JUCE base requirements
